scope: GDN commit operator screening only; no whole-model or HTTP speed claim. Production source/executable/config not modified by this experiment.
toolchain: Intel oneAPI DPC++2025.3; Level Zero; /O2 /fp:precise; per-kernel device code splitting; correctly rounded fp32 divide/sqrt
baseline: Current cross-layer fused history/state ESIMD commit; eight columns,128 rows,256 GRF per work item.36 independent layers,key heads16,value heads48,channels10240.
timing_method: Eager direct submissions,one fresh process per fixed variant; each shape uses A/B/A/B/A.Each phase resets and validates full state,warms3x64 rounds,retains9x128 rounds,one queue wait per batch.Fixed CPU affinity4 and above-normal process priority.Host submission through queue completion,us per36-layer round.
rule_before_measurement: Four fixed variants, no resampling. Screen each with shape-local A/B/A/B/A. Confirm the best eligible variant in two fresh processes. Capacity4/6 evaluated separately: all positive acceptance counts must have eligible pairs (absolute adjacent baseline drift<=3%), each shape pooled throughput gain>0 and capacity geometric mean gain>=1%, in screen and confirmation. Require full bitwise state/history/guards/read-only inputs/dynamic graph/refusal checks. Measure direct eager submissions, matching the current configured verifier mode. Graph attempt invalid, retained without speed claims.
aggregation: Each candidate phase compared with geometric mean of adjacent baseline phase medians.Eligible if absolute baseline drift<=3%.Per-shape gain pools eligible time ratios geometrically;capacity gain weights each shape equally.Positive means higher throughput;negative means lower throughput.
correctness_scope: 71 checks per variant:full bitwise state,CPU history,zero through full acceptance,partial/nonzero global/local layer offsets,guards,read-only inputs,dynamic graph replay and refused calls.Only batched fused commits changed in these candidates.

invalid_graph_attempt.reason: Stopped after command-graph baseline showed sustained within-phase growth and excessive adjacent baseline drift. No optimization decision from this attempt. All raw files retained.

local_reproduction: build-sycl-a770-esimd-tune-20261024; frozen headers/source,prepare.py,run.py,run-eager.py,preparation.json,eager-preparation.json and all raw logs retained.Original graph attempt failed calibration and was stopped;use a fresh directory for any new experiment.
